components.name: Quiet Button

components.css: .ds-choices { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; background: #f4f1f5; } .ds-choice { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; color: #1d1620; font-family: Assistant, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; transition: opacity 120ms ease-out; } .ds-choice:active { opacity: 0.65; } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d1620; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-choice[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #1d1620; color: #ffffff; } .ds-choice-must[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #f6b443; color: #20160a; } .ds-choice-avoid { text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 48px white field with a hairline ring and a soft label above.
components.css: .ds-field-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 16px; background: #f4f1f5; color: #655b6a; font-family: Assistant, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-field { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(29, 22, 32, 0.08); color: #1d1620; font: inherit; font-size: 1.0625rem; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #655b6a; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d1620; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-panel { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 22px; background: #ffffff; font-family: Assistant, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #1d1620; } .ds-row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 64px; padding: 0 14px; } .ds-row + .ds-row::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; inset-inline: 70px 0; height: 1px; background: rgba(29, 22, 32, 0.08); } .ds-photo { flex: none; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; background: #c8643c; } .ds-photo-dark { opacity: 0.3; filter: grayscale(0.9); } .ds-name { flex: 1; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-row-avoid .ds-name { color: #655b6a; text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-verdict { color: #655b6a; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-verdict-good { color: #1d1620; font-weight: 600; } .ds-verdict-avoid { text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-price { color: #655b6a; font-size: 0.875rem; }

narrative.overview:
A pale, aubergine-tinted table with white rounded panels laid on it, aubergine ink for every word, and one amber accent. The dish photos are the only strong colour on screen, so a screen reads by its pictures first and its words second. Everything else stays quiet: plain titles on the ground, one line per row, hairline dividers inside white panels, and a floating tab capsule with a round amber camera button beside it.

Fading is the verdict. What is worth ordering keeps its full colour and size (a חובה להזמין dish is a large photo tile); what to skip loses colour step by step: a לא משהו photo is dimmed, a לא להזמין photo is dimmed further and greyed, their names turn soft and a לא להזמין name is struck through. The verdict word is always written beside the dish, and the word itself never fades.

The app is Hebrew and right to left, runs as an iPhone Home Screen app on Ionic in iOS mode, and has a light appearance only. It replaced the "Glazed plates" look (cobalt shell, Suez One titles, round photos in coloured verdict rims), which the owner retired on 2026-11-15 (issues #12 and #13).
keyCharacteristics: Pale aubergine ground, white 22px panels, aubergine ink, one amber accent.
Dish photos are rounded squares and the only strong colour.
Fading is the verdict; the verdict word is always written.
One line per row; long text sits behind a tap.
Floating, rounded bottom bar; no header blocks.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber marks the camera action, the must-order verdict and the waiting dot, nothing else. A new screen that wants a second accent uses ink instead.

rules.name: The Photos Carry Colour Rule
rules.body: No surface, header, border or verdict gets a hue of its own; colour on screen comes from the dish photos and the one amber.

rules.name: The Faint-On-White Rule
rules.body: Ink Faint passes 4.5:1 only on Panel White (4.52:1). Text on the ground or on Raised Lilac uses Ink Soft or darker.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Assistant only, weights 400/600/700/800. No display face, no italics.

rules.name: The Verdict Word Rule
rules.body: A verdict is always a written word (spec 15). Fading applies to photos and dish names, never to the verdict word, which keeps 4.5:1 on its ground.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels, rows, fields and chips carry no shadow. Depth beyond tone is reserved for the floating bar and the must-order tiles.

dos: Do round the corners of every panel, tile, bar, button and photo (22px panels, 14px fields and row photos, pills for controls).
Do keep screens calm: plain bold titles on the ground, one line of facts per row, long text (notes) behind a tap.
Do keep amber to the camera action, the חובה להזמין chip and the waiting dot.
Do show a verdict by its word, and show what to skip by fading the photo and softening the name, striking לא להזמין.
Do let the dish photos be the colour; give surfaces only the aubergine neutrals.
Do draw the app icon as solid shapes with soft depth (a deep aubergine fork and knife on amber, inside the maskable safe zone); in-app icons are 1.8px round line icons.
Do press with opacity (65%, 120ms) and focus with a 2px ink outline.
donts: Don't add a coloured header block or band; top-level titles sit as plain text on the ground.
Don't add ornaments: no patterned strips, motif borders, dotted bands or decorative gradients. The only gradients are the functional bar scrim and the filter-row edge fade.
Don't make photos circles or put coloured rims or verdict rings around them.
Don't give verdicts colours of their own or fade a verdict word below 4.5:1.
Don't add a second accent colour or a second typeface.
Don't put more than one line of facts on a row or tile.
Don't ship a dark appearance; the app is light only.
Don't draw app icons as thin outlines or flat two-colour marks.
